text:
alex: quick Q — if we flip the hosted API default model from redwood-v1 to redwood-v2, what's our compatibility guarantee? Are we doing a 90-day deprecation for unpinned clients? cc @maria

maria: short answer: yes we want a 90-day window but need to confirm rollback path. plan: announce, add response header, and keep old model available as /models/redwood-v1 until end of window :calendar:

sam: infra question — how will fallback work for clients that don't pass model param? If capacity for v2 is constrained, do we auto-route to v1 or fail?

jen: runtime note — we will serve by policy: if client did not pin, requests go to default model (v2) unless explicit fallback policy set. We can enable automatic fallback -> v1 on 503s for a canary period. Implementation flag: `default_model_fallback: true`.

kevin: comms: recommend staged emails, changelog entry, and console banner. timeline suggestion: announce next Tue, 90-day deprecation, then reminders at 60/30/14/7 days. Also ship a migration guide with example curl + SDK snippet.

alex: can you paste sample header we should include so client libs can detect? :eyes:

jen: sure — header we'll add is `X-Redwood-Model: redwood-v2` and `X-Redwood-Default-Version: v2` and we will include a `Deprecation` header with the end date. Example curl for pinned request:
```
curl -H "Authorization: Bearer $TOKEN" \
     -H "X-Redwood-Model: redwood-v1" \
     https://api.redwood.inference/v1/generate
```

sam: SGTM. small ask: can we add a routing metric in the console to show % requests hitting pinned vs default? that helps validate rollout and spot accidental pinning.

maria: yes — that's on the migration epic. i'll prioritize the telemetry card. @jen can you file a small PR to expose the metric? :thumbsup:

jen: on it, filing PR now — https://github.com/redwood-inference/runtime/pull/1423 (adds header + simple metric).

deploy-bot: deploy queued — canary to prod in 15m for header change (build #2021).

kevin: once header lands, ops will push the first announce. i'll draft the blog + console banner and drop it into #marketing for review.

alex: thanks everyone. leaving this thread open for async Qs. if anything urgent, ping me or i'll do a 10-min sync tomorrow at 10:30am to walk through rollback playbook.
